request.spec:
A button downloads the people of the whole tree as a CSV file: a header line
sheet,name,grade,due-total then one line per person, this sheet first in list order, then the
other sheets of the tree by sheet id.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A button downloads the people of the whole tree as a CSV file: a header line
sheet,name,grade,due-total then one line per person, this sheet first in list order, then the
other sheets of the tree by sheet id.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
There's now an **Export tree people (CSV)** button (`export-tree`) that downloads everyone in the sheet's tree. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**The export** (`src/main/frontend/features/export/export.slot.tsx`): the header is `sheet,name,grade,due-total`. This sheet's people come first in list order, then the other sheets of the tree (its parents and children) by sheet id. Each sheet is read fresh from the store when the button is pressed. Grades and due-totals are the same as each sheet's own list shows; a person whose grade has no rate gets `n/a`.

**Reuse with tree search** (`features/treesearch/treeSearch.ts`): the existing tree search already loaded every sheet in the tree and worked out due-totals. I moved that part into a new shared function, `treePeople`, used by both the export and the search. The search works as before.

**One server fix outside the request:** the first run failed "tree export scenario 2", which tests existing features, not the new button. Waiving a claim's late charge didn't write the `ROLLUP`/`TOTALS` audit lines that other claim actions like defer write. I added those two steps to `waive.POST.yml`, copying how `defer.POST.yml` does it. Waiving a claim now writes those extra lines to the audit file.
